00076 UIAccelerationSingleton::UIAccelerationSingleton()
00077 {
00078   UIAccelerationSingletonPeer* peer = [UIAccelerationSingletonPeer alloc];
00079   [peer setOwner:this];
00080   
00081   UIAccelerometer *accel = [UIAccelerometer sharedAccelerometer];
00082   
00083   [accel setDelegate:peer]; 
00084   
00085   //printf("UIAccelerometer update interval = %f\n", [accel updateInterval]);
00086   
00087   accel.updateInterval = 1024.0 / 44100.0;
00088   
00089   printf("UIAccelerometer update interval = %f\n", [accel updateInterval]);
00090   
00091   voidPeer = (void*)peer;
00092 }
00093 
00094 UIAccelerationSingleton::~UIAccelerationSingleton()
00095 {
00096   UIAccelerationSingletonPeer* peer = (UIAccelerationSingletonPeer*)voidPeer;
00097   [peer dealloc];
00098 }

00106 void UIAccelerationSingleton::set(double newX, double newY, double newZ) throw()
00107 {
00108 //  printf("accel: %f %f %f\n", newX, newY, newZ);
00109   
00110   double newDx = newX-x;
00111   double newDy = newY-y;
00112   double newDz = newZ-z;
00113   
00114   ddx = newDx-dx;
00115   ddy = newDy-dy;
00116   ddz = newDz-dz;
00117   
00118   dx = newDx;
00119   dy = newDy;
00120   dz = newDz;
00121   
00122   x = newX;
00123   y = newY;
00124   z = newZ;
00125 }

00127 double UIAccelerationSingleton::get(Directions direction) throw()
00128 {
00129   switch(direction)
00130   {
00131     case AccelerationX: return x;
00132     case AccelerationY: return y;
00133     case AccelerationZ: return z;
00134     case DeltaX: return dx;
00135     case DeltaY: return dy;
00136     case DeltaZ: return dz;
00137     case DeltaDeltaX: return ddx;
00138     case DeltaDeltaY: return ddy;
00139     case DeltaDeltaZ: return ddz;
00140     default: return 0.0;
00141   }
00142 }
00143 
00144 double* UIAccelerationSingleton::getPtr(Directions direction) throw()
00145 {
00146   switch(direction)
00147   {
00148     case AccelerationX: return &x;
00149     case AccelerationY: return &y;
00150     case AccelerationZ: return &z;
00151     case DeltaX: return &dx;
00152     case DeltaY: return &dy;
00153     case DeltaZ: return &dz;
00154     case DeltaDeltaX: return &ddx;
00155     case DeltaDeltaY: return &ddy;
00156     case DeltaDeltaZ: return &ddz;
00157     default: return (double*)(&zero); // not sure about this!
00158   }
00159 }
